wu: Warm-up: 'Quiz Relay' in teams of 4. Students race to write 3 S1 review words (e.g., 'present perfect', 'past continuous') on the board. First team to write all 3 correctly wins a point.
wuAlt: Alternative 1: 'Word Association Chain' - students say one S1 word related to the previous word.
Alternative 2: 'Quick Draw' - teacher draws a S1 grammar concept (e.g., 'used to'), students guess.
pres: Presentation: Teacher shows a PET-style writing task example (email to a friend). Model sentences: 'I have been to...', 'I used to live...'. Check understanding by asking: 'What tense is used for experiences?'
presAlt: Alternative 1: Use flashcards for 'present perfect' vs 'past simple' with visuals (e.g., 'travel' icons).
Alternative 2: Realia - show old photos to elicit 'used to' sentences.
prac: Guided practice: 'Grammar Match-Up' - students match sentence halves (e.g., 'I have never...' with '...been to the USA'). Teacher circulates to correct errors.
pracAlt: Alternative 1: 'Sentence Auction' - students bet on correct S1 grammar sentences.
Alternative 2: 'Find Someone Who...' survey with S1 questions.
ls: Listening slot: PET-style listening task (audio about a teen's holiday). Students answer 5 multiple-choice questions. Play audio twice, then review answers as a class.
re: Reactivation game: 'Stand Up If...' - teacher says S1 review prompts (e.g., 'Stand up if you have ever eaten camel meat'), students stand up and say a full sentence.
prod: Production task: Paired speaking task - 'My Dream Vacation'. Students take 2-minute turns describing their dream trip using S1 grammar. Teacher assesses using a checklist.
rw: Reading and writing slot: Read a short text about Moroccan festivals (e.g., Green March), then write 60-word email to a friend about a festival they enjoyed. Include 1 'present perfect' sentence.
st: Story / song + goodbye: Teacher tells a short story about a teen's first time in Casablanca. Close with: 'Today we reviewed S1 for our assessment. Thank you for your hard work!'
g: Teams race to write 3 S1 words on the board.
Match sentence halves for S1 grammar.
Stand and speak when prompted with S1 grammar.
diff: Fast finishers: Write an extra paragraph about their dream vacation.
Support learners: Use a sentence frame for the email (e.g., 'I have... because...').
hw: Homework 1: Write 5 sentences about your family using 'used to'.
Homework 2: Record yourself describing your favorite festival (1-2 min).
Homework 3: Create a quiz with 5 S1 review questions for a friend.
tip: Use Moroccan cultural examples (e.g., 'Green March') to make grammar practice relatable and boost engagement.
checklist: I can use present perfect for experiences.
I can describe past habits with 'used to'.
I can write a 60-word email about a festival.
I can answer PET-style listening questions.
I can speak for 2 minutes about my dream vacation.
I can use 0/1 conditionals in sentences.
I can identify relative clauses in texts.
